title: [GMCP 203.033.06] Operations and evidence: Identity, tenancy, state-handle, and data isolation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-033-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Every request, subscription, task, cache entry, callback and explicit state handle is bound to an authenticated principal, tenant, server and policy epoch. Authorization is rechecked on use, revocation propagates promptly, quotas and storage are isolated, administrator access is explicit, and cross-tenant timing, identifier-guessing, stale-handle and confused-deputy tests disclose or mutate nothing. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
